reference.observation: Raw independent Image.previewPrefixCls (full viewer namespace, including empty) precedes separate public derived-prefix counterparts in styled. Official Image passes the prop to rc-image but registers CSS only for base Image prefix. Independent namespaces lose preview CSS; even canonical ant-image-preview is unstyled before canonical Image registers its stylesheet. Native supplies missing CSS while retaining raw namespace resolution, stable dialog and button semantics. Group owns its base prefix and ignores child previewPrefixCls.
